orderId.description: The customer order the returned group belongs to.

lines.description: The order lines to return, picked by lineNo. At most 50 lines per return.

lineNo.description: The order line's lineNo, resolved against the placed group.

unitPriceCents.description: Optional; the storefront-declared unit price in cents. Absent means KEEP can never be chosen (returned `pricesAbsent` true). Stored for the disposition decision only; never published.

reason.description: The enum reason code; free text is never accepted (the PII rule).

method.description: How the shopper hands the package back. PICKUP requires a window and is never KEEP.

pickupWindowStart.description: Required with PICKUP; both bounds must be given and lie inside [authorizedAt, expiresAt].

pickupWindowEnd.description: Required with PICKUP; both bounds must be given and lie inside [authorizedAt, expiresAt].
